spec.sequence: Coming down the track from the Border road, the Hist crown shows first over the trees, then the lodge roof and the smoke from the common.
spec.wayfinding: The track ends at the top of the village; the way runs down past the tree-minder's house to the common.

spec.sequence: Walking up the footpath from the south-west, the spring house and the jars at its lip show first, then the Hist above it and the canoes on the bank beyond.
spec.wayfinding: The footpath passes the spring house; the way up to the common leaves it just past the spring.

spec.value: Founded at the Panther fork on springs that can be drunk unboiled.
The tribe is the interior's last friendly stop. Water is free; beds and rope are sold at high prices.
The Hist is sick and the village blames salt from upstream. Traffic on the Helstrom track brings cult couriers and factors whom the tribe distrusts.
Firm ground where clean water rises at a stone lip, at the last dry footing before the Helstrom approach.
If the spring soured, the village would move within a season.

value.loreSource: settlement-register row Greenspring (M3, a freshwater village at the fork); record npcs merchant (single) and family (band); notable slots tree-minder, root-herald, spring-keeper
value.why: Five households and the lodge's guests. Seven buildings stand: six houses and the spring house, round one common with the Hist and the landing.
